title: How An Elephant Changes The Position

moves.label: Guard the diagonal
moves.spokenText: Move 1. Red elephant moves from file 3, rank 10 to file 5, rank 8 to guard the central diagonal. Now watch the reply. The likely response is to block the elephant eye. After that response, the position changes: the bishop becomes restricted. The rule to remember is the elephant eye and the river limit.
moves.captionText: Move 1: Elephant file 3, rank 10 → file 5, rank 8. Guard the central diagonal.
